description: Ex-US Navy BuNo 34759, allocated RAF FP607 but never served with the RAF, diverted to the SAAF as 6432 and converted to a transport for 28 Squadron in June 1946. Passed to the South African Airways Technical School as TS305 on 27 November 1959 and thence to the Dickie Fritz MOTH complex, where it has stood since the late 1950s or early 1960s. Photographed there in May 1987, October 2002 and January 2008, and recorded as still on display as late as October 2021. Stands inside the walled MOTH grounds. One of very few complete Ventura airframes anywhere.

Ex-SAAF transport helicopter listed on the SAAF's own inventory of complete ex-SAAF airframes displayed away from air force property as being at the Dickie Fritz MOTH Shellhole, Edenvale, alongside Ventura 6432. Recorded there in an enthusiast survey in 2013. No independent sighting later than that was found, so its continued presence is unconfirmed.
